name: Crossroads Supply Crate
summary: Stolen provisions for the Crossroads lie scattered among Razormane camps in the Barrens. A raided caravan left the settlement short of food, tools, and necessities.

sections.title: Plundered Provisions
sections.body: Razormane quilboar raided a caravan carrying supplies to the Crossroads. The crates were dragged into nearby camps among the underbrush and dirt dens. Thork, the settlement's commander, seeks their return before the outpost runs dangerously low on food, tools, and necessities.

faq.answer: The crates hold food, tools, and other provisions meant for the Horde settlement of the Crossroads. A Razormane attack scattered them after the quilboar raided a supply caravan on the Barrens roads.
The Razormane quilboar attacked the caravan and hauled the crates to their nearby thorned camps to feast and hoard the spoils.

faq.q: Who is looking for these crates?
faq.answer: Thork, an orc officer stationed at the Crossroads, seeks the stolen crates so the garrison and local inhabitants remain supplied.
The crates lie scattered across Razormane quilboar camps in the surrounding Barrens.

angles.text: The Crossroads links Durotar, Mulgore, and the northern wildlands. Its supplies help protect Horde travel and logistics across Kalimdor.
